{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) are present
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders after parsing: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Now filter to completed orders only, excluding QA orders
completed = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)]
print(f'Number of completed, non-QA orders: {len(completed)}')

# Check the distribution of channels
print(f'Channel distribution:
{completed["channel"].value_counts()}')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
print(f'Customer segment by channel:
{completed.groupby("channel")["customer_segment"].value_counts()}')"}
